facts: HorizonForge reference 8 identifies LangTraj by Chang et al., arXiv:2504.11521.
Official LangTraj code repository currently contains only README.md and DATASET.md; no inference/scene-index conversion source exists in inspected tree.

Inter-Drive uses WOMD v1.2 scenario IDs of sixteen hexadecimal characters as JSON filenames; released example JSON stores agent track IDs and interaction descriptions, not Perception segment/context IDs.
Official Inter-Drive release tree contains fifteen annotation JSON examples under val_interactive plus README and gitattributes.
ChatSim uses complete segment basenames as source/output scene names. process_waymo.py lines 94-98 strips file extension/prefix through segment and retains full segment name.
ChatSim static32 list has explicit segment names; download script tries each exact name in both v1.4.2 training and validation buckets. No 004..140 ordinal contract is defined.
No official evidence found in this bounded search that LangTraj inherits ChatSim numbering or that HorizonSuite labels are derived from ChatSim list positions.

stopping_point: Official LangTraj tree has no executable conversion or numbering manifest; official Inter-Drive example release has no scenario-to-Perception crosswalk; ChatSim retains full segment names. Further numbered hypotheses would be unsupported, so no broader search or media/raw-data download was performed.
evidence_grade: A for observed official file formats/naming; unavailable for a HorizonForge-to-context join
